adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb a `feed_key` method is defined (building a Redis-style cache key from `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url`) but it is never referenced anywhere in the diff. The polling implementation always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with no conditional GET / caching logic, so the reviewer’s point about an unused cache key and always refetching the feed is grounded. However, this is a performance/efficiency/incompleteness concern rather than a verifiable correctness defect introduced by the diff.
